connector.name: Icemoon - control a real iPhone with AI
connector.registryDescription: Control real, physical iPhones with AI: screen reading, human-like touch, no jailbreak.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package icemoon-mcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace app.icemoon, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: ICEMOON_APP
env.description: Path to AutomationStudio.app if it is not in /Applications. The Icemoon macOS app must be installed and licensed — get it at https://icemoon.app

env.name: ICEMOON_DASHBOARD_URL
env.description: Where the running Icemoon app listens locally. Defaults to http://127.0.0.1:8088
